comment: Modeling harness library. 'core.md' is always prepended. EVERY file in 'playbooks' is ALWAYS provided to the backend; there is no exclusive mode. The agent applies each playbook whose 'trigger' matches the part's character or how it will be used, and ignores the ones that don't apply. To extend the harness, drop a <id>.md file into this directory and add an entry below with a short 'trigger'. 'lessons.md' is always included: it carries distilled rules from real failed/rejected tasks — append an entry there after every such failure, and promote matured rules into the right playbook.

playbooks.label: Parametrická robustnost
playbooks.trigger: always — every model must stay a robust, editable, single watertight parametric solid

playbooks.label: Kontrola kvality (QA)
playbooks.trigger: always — run the QA checklist before declaring the task done

playbooks.label: Modelování nového tvaru
playbooks.trigger: you are turning a description into new geometry

playbooks.label: Oprava / doladění
playbooks.trigger: you are correcting a defect in an existing model

playbooks.label: Rozměry běžných předmětů
playbooks.trigger: the part holds, carries, mounts or mates with a real-world object (a roll, a phone, a board, a bearing, a cable) — including objects you believe you already know the size of

playbooks.label: Rešerše rozměrů
playbooks.trigger: the spec references a real object/standard whose dimensions must be looked up

playbooks.label: Rešerše tvaru a funkce
playbooks.trigger: the request names a real-world object/product/mechanism whose shape/function should be grounded in references (proportions, topology, functional interfaces) — distinct from research, which grounds dimensions

playbooks.label: Knihovna vzorů
playbooks.trigger: the part uses a recurring mechanical feature (threaded boss, snap-fit, rib/gusset, heat-set insert, hinge clearance, screw counterbore) — index of on-demand micro-recipes under patterns/

playbooks.label: 3D tisk (FDM/FFF)
playbooks.trigger: the part will be 3D printed by filament — design it support-minimal

playbooks.label: Výroba (slice / tisk)
playbooks.trigger: the request asks to slice, print, or send the model to a printer ('naslicuj', 'vytiskni', 'pošli na tiskárnu'), alone or combined with modeling in one request

playbooks.label: Materiály
playbooks.trigger: always when the part will be manufactured — pick and state the material early; mandatory for 3D-printed or load-bearing parts

playbooks.label: Mechanika / dimenzování
playbooks.trigger: the part carries load, transmits force/torque, or deflects — size it with numbers, not vibes

playbooks.label: Pevnostní návrh
playbooks.trigger: the part carries structural or dynamic load and must be strong enough

playbooks.label: Tolerance / uložení
playbooks.trigger: parts must fit together or a functional dimension must hold a tolerance

playbooks.label: Sestava / rozhraní dílů
playbooks.trigger: the design has multiple parts that must fit, move or mate

playbooks.label: Spojovací prvky / závity
playbooks.trigger: the design uses screws, threads, inserts, bosses or snap-fits

playbooks.label: Reálný spojovací materiál a ozubení
playbooks.trigger: the design is an assembly where real screws/nuts/threaded rod should be shown, or it involves gears — not only printed parts

playbooks.label: Krabičky / kryty
playbooks.trigger: the part is a housing, box or enclosure

playbooks.label: Vstřikování (DfM)
playbooks.trigger: the part will be injection moulded

playbooks.label: Plech
playbooks.trigger: the part is made from bent sheet metal
